answer: Zero-knowledge proof of post-epoch generation at the atlas: each identity submits a zk-SNARK proving it solved a unique epoch nonce, binding work to one address. The signal is verifiability — a farm must re-prove per identity, costing 500 CPU-hours (~$12) each. At the zenith of cheap forgery, faking 100 IDs burns $1,200 plus proof-gen overhead, while honest nodes pay once. Cost scales linearly with identities, so the mechanism works because duplication becomes strictly unprofitable.
